messages:
Alex R: Quick async check-in on the current sprint — need quick ownership + ETA on three things: kernel backpressure shim, continuous-batching stabilization, KV-cache TTL heuristics. Can owners drop short status + blockers? :eyes: https://redwood.internal/sprints/heatmap
Priya K: Kernel shim PR is in review: PR #4128. CI failing on one integration test (race with batch window). Failing log:
```
batch_window_test: timeout waiting for flush (120s)
stack: runtime/kv/flush.go:142
```
I think it's a timing issue; working on adding deterministic clock. ETA EOD PST for fix. Owner: priya.
Marco L: Continuous-batching: implemented adaptive window but depends on eng-platform node-rebalance API (tickets: PLAT-221). PLAT says they can deliver a minimal variant by Thu. If we don't get it we'll fall back to static windows. Owner: marco. ETA tentative Fri.
Sam T: Canary in staging showed elevated tail latency when first warmup hits backend. Alert: staging/kb-warmup > 350ms p99 for 10m. Deploy bot noted:
deploy-bot: [staging] rollout v0.12.3 -> failed healthcheck on node-3
I'd suggest lowering aggressiveness of prefetch until kernel shim lands. I can adjust threshold with:
`kubectl set env deploy/runtime PREFETCH_RATE=0.6 --namespace=staging`
Ping me before changing prod.
Jen P: From product side — success criteria for this sprint: p99 latency <= 220ms on synthetic chat load, KV hit rate >= 92% after warmup, and no more than 1 rollback in canary. If any owner expects to miss, say so now so we can re-scope.
Alex R: Good. Priya — if deterministic clock fix is quick, can you also add a small stress test targeting batch window boundaries? If you need a harness I'll wire one up. Marco — can you confirm PLAT-221 owner and if they can scope a minimal API (no autoscaling, just allocation)?
Priya K: Yep will add stress test. PR will include a new deterministic_clock_test and a note in the changelog. Marking owner: priya_k.
Marco L: PLAT-221 owner is @natalie_p. I've pinged her in PLAT channel; she said Thu morning window. I'll follow up. If Thu misses, we degrade to static 40ms window.
Sam T: I'll hold the prefetch throttle change in staging until priya confirms. Also adding a temporary alert suppression for the canary run:
`/alerts mute staging/kb-warmup 2h --reason "ci warmup run"`
deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollback policy: on 2 failed healthchecks within 5m -> rollback
Jen P: Thanks — please add a one-line note in the sprint board if you change ETA so PMs see it. I'll update milestone 1.2 to reflect possible partial delivery.
Alex R: OK — I'll consolidate this into the sprint checklist and ping owners tomorrow morning with the consolidated plan. :white_check_mark:
